summary: Read the four targets and the pages around them: each target's own links, the pages the map lists at one and two hops, and a body-text search of the whole vault for each target's name to find sentences that already point at it. CHILD and SCHEMA — Reference had real unwired sentences: nine pages cite them in prose while the typed links sit elsewhere, so I propose five inbound for CHILD (Concierge, Deposit Ceremony, Palace Philosophies, Cooperation Yields Agency, SUBSTRATE, with the last two the most skippable) and five for SCHEMA — Reference (CHILD, Substrate Skill, The Scroll, How the Palace Commits, Pheromone Trail). Operator Memory and Can an Instrument Notice Where the Work Stops? get none: every page that genuinely belongs beside them (CHILD, Palace as Context Injection System, Weave Ceremony, Weaving Memory into the Palace; Creative Coach, Reflective Practice, Retrospective Delay) already carries the pair's one link, pointing outward from the newcomer, and the pages at two hops (Closing Well, Return Ceremony, Meadows and an Artist's Career, Quadratic Interpolation in DSP, Playful Interface Design) share a theme but not a sentence, so linking them would be manufactured. What I could not settle: whether the weave wants a body wikilink only (no new typed edge) from Creative Coach § If the room held three to the Can-an-Instrument question and from Weave Ceremony's memory-sweep paragraph to Operator Memory, since a prose pointer is the honest way to reach those two; and the Palace Philosophies and Cooperation Yields Agency proposals for CHILD overlap, so one may do. Five bare links got verdicts: four labels (Resonant Link Labels, Project Stewardship System, Pages as Agents, Concierge to Reflective Practice) and one cut (Lateral Access to Creative Coach).
